review: Resolve catalog conflicts by preserving archive and per-ingress reader controls. Strengthen the wipe to remove the complete owned archive directory; replay must work without any retained archive side file.
author_negative_controls: All four supplied logs match their recorded SHA256, compile successfully and fail at the intended CRC, exact-byte, catalog-copy or session assertion. They precede the complete-directory-wipe strengthening.
limitations: One recording and segment, copied from the same stopped archive. No independent peer recording, multi-segment, live ingress/executor or load-during-fault proof. Reconciliation reruns all217 controls, then the changed archive target only after strengthening its wipe; no claim of a second full217 run.
